bullets.text: calm-ish. one eyebrow still up from something yesterday, can't remember what.
clear and cold at okunoin. duck carries a line: impersonalize the personal. two hundred thousand gravestones got there first.
the umbrella drying by the door since tuesday has quietly become furniture. nobody wants to be the one to close it.
re-gluing a chair leg. the clamp does all the work and gets none of the credit.
